en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style illustration of a broad cobblestoned square with tram tracks running through it. On the left is a row of ornate multi‑story buildings with arcades; one façade features elaborate stucco decoration and a projecting sign or figure. The square is animated by horse‑drawn carts, pedestrians, and market stalls with umbrellas to the right. In the background stands a large classical building with many windows and a central pediment, and farther back a church tower rises along the street axis. The overall look is of a historic European market square.
